summary: Tested Provisional Bulk Orders Invoice & Payout Extensions - All 10 backend tests pass. Vendor invoice required for mark-goods-ready, admin override works, actual_quantity used for payout calculation, vendor_invoice_* fields auto-stamped on payout.
seed_data_creation: Created provisional test orders via MongoDB for testing (cleaned up after tests)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Provisional Bulk Orders Invoice & Payout Extensions verified. Key features: (1) vendor_invoice payload required for vendor caller on mark-goods-ready (url, invoice_number, invoice_date mandatory), (2) admin can skip invoice (override path), (3) vendor_invoices array persisted on order keyed by seller_id, (4) materialize_payouts uses actual_quantity for gross/commission calculation, (5) payout doc carries vendor_invoice_* fields (url, number, date, amount, status='uploaded', source='mark_goods_ready'), (6) non-provisional orders fall back to ordered quantity, (7) legacy upload via /api/vendor/payouts/{id}/upload-invoice still functional.

POST /api/orders/{order_id}/mark-goods-r.details: Vendor caller must provide vendor_invoice with url, invoice_number, invoice_date. Missing any → 400 with clear error.
Admin caller can submit without vendor_invoice (override path for manual handling).

vendor_invoices array persistence.details: order.vendor_invoices = [{seller_id, url, filename, invoice_number, invoice_date, amount, uploaded_at}] keyed by seller_id.

materialize_payouts uses actual_quantity.details: Payout gross = actual_quantity × rate (not ordered quantity). Tested with ordered=100, actual=92 → gross=92×150=13800.

payout carries vendor_invoice_* fields.details: When order has vendor_invoices entry for seller, payout doc has vendor_invoice_url, vendor_invoice_number, vendor_invoice_date, vendor_invoice_amount, vendor_invoice_status='uploaded', vendor_invoice_source='mark_goods_ready'.

non-provisional fallback.details: Non-provisional orders (no actual_quantity) use ordered quantity for payout calculation.

legacy invoice upload.details: /api/vendor/payouts/{id}/upload-invoice still functional for vendors who didn't upload at mark-goods-ready time.
